mapper.select:
select
from ord_dis_presale_assets where store_code = #{storeCode} and is_delete = 0

select pa.id, pa.store_code, pa.store_name,
(select count(1) from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail pad where pad.assets_id = pa.id) as total_sku_qty, (select IFNULL(sum(pad.surplus_quantity),0) from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail pad where pad.assets_id = pa.id) as total_surplus_goods_qty, pa.creator, pa.org_code, pa.biz_org_code, pa.create_time, pa.updater, pa.update_time, pa.is_delete from ord_dis_presale_assets pa where 1 = 1
and pa.store_code in
#{item}
and pa.store_code = #{storeCode}
and pa.store_name like concat('%',#{storeName},'%')
and exists(select 1 from ord_dis_presale_assets_detail pad where pad.assets_id = pa.id and pad.goods_code = #{goodsCode})
and pa.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and pa.is_delete = 0
